title: Thermodynamically Constrained Information Geometric Regularization for Compressible Flows
summary: We construct and analyze a thermodynamic extension of the recently proposed information geometric regularization of Cao and Schäfer. The construction extends their shock-mitigating Hessian metric geometry using the Shannon entropy to constrain the regularized motion based on a thermodynamic length. Reformulating the equations in terms of mass and specific entropy explicitly connects the thermodynamic state to a position in the diffeomorphism group, allowing for a derivation of the regularized equations using an information geometric mechanics formalism based on geodesics on a Hessian…
